title: Annexin-V binds subpopulation of immune cells altering its interpretation as an
abstract: In cells undergoing apoptosis phosphatidylserine, a major component of the plasma membrane, translocates to the outer leaflet where it provides eat-me signals for phagocytic recognition and is bound by annexin-V, an apoptotic marker.
